Ganesh II is the 7,118 m Ganesh NW summit, wholly in Nepal (Gorkha). Wikidata describes it as a mountain in Nepal. Nepali Wikipedia uses the form गणेश-II in its Ganesh Himal caption (S14); the earlier proposed गणेश दोस्रो was derived and is not attested. Reviewer required.

Pabil is Ganesh IV (7,104 m), wholly in Nepal (Gorkha); S15 describes it as a mountain in Nepal. The earlier "Ganesh III" alias was wrong: Ganesh III is Salasungo (7,043 m), a separate summit not in this list. Nepali name पविल per S14; language review pending.

Proposed Nepali label थुलागी चुली; reviewer required. No Nepali-language attestation was found; the label is a transliteration. English Wikipedia gives the district as Gorkha, but its own coordinate and the Wikidata coordinate both fall inside Nashong, Manang (OSM reverse geocode, S07); the master assignment of 402 Manang is retained and the Wikipedia district field is treated as an error. Editorial decision 29 Oct 2026: recorded as transliterated (no attested Nepali form found in any source).

Border peak with China, confirmed by S15. District Manang (Nar Phu) is supported by S15 and multiple route sources; the high-priority geo-review flag is caused by the simplified district polygon, not by a location dispute. Nepali Wikipedia and the English Wikipedia article carry रत्नचुली (S14;S15), while Nepali trekking usage also has रत्न चुली (S23); reviewer to confirm the form.
